div.head: Af 71
div.ab: Gif monnes eage him mon ofaslea oððe his hond oþþe his fót, ðær geð gelic bot to eallum: VI peningas ⁊ VI scillingas ⁊ LX scll' ⁊ þriddan dæl peniges.
Gif monnes eage him mon ófaslea oððe his hand oððe his fot, ðær gæð gelic bot to eallum: VI pæningas ⁊ VI scill. ⁊ LX scill. ⁊ ðriddan dǽl pæninges.
Si quis oculum uel manum uel pedem excutiat alicui, parem emendationem componat de singulis, id est LXVI solid. et VI den. et terciam partem unius denarii.
Gif monnes eage him mon ófaslea oððe his hand oððe his fot, ðær gæð gelic bot to eallum: VI pæningas ⁊ VI scill ⁊ LX scill ⁊ ðriddan dæl pæninges.
If someone strikes a man’s eye from him, or his hand or his foot, an equal compensation applies to all: 6 pennies and 6 shillings and 60 shillings and a third of a penny.
If a man's eye is knocked out, or if his hand or foot is struck off, the same compensation shall follow them all—6 pennies, 66 shillings and the third part of a penny.

Wenn man jemandes Auge ihm ausschlägt oder seine Hand oder seinen Fuss [abhaut], da tritt gleiche Busse für alle [drei Fälle] ein: 6 Pfennige und 6 Schill. und 60 Schill. und dritten Theil eines Pfennigs.
If someone knocks out a person’s eye or [cuts off] his hand or his foot, the same compensation applies to all [three cases]: 6 pence and 6 shillings and 60 shillings and a third of a penny.
